subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` opt-out for `agents-skills-personal`, and should that API be a typed source-disable list or a narrower personal-source toggle?
rationale: The issue is valid, but adding a new config key changes public skills-loading behavior and the repository policy sets a high bar for new config surface.

options.title: Add typed source-disable list
options.body: Expose a bounded `skills.load.disabledSources` style setting with known source ids, default it to empty, and make loader, watcher, status, docs, and tests honor it.

options.title: Add personal-source toggle only
options.body: Expose a narrower boolean for `~/.agents/skills` that solves this report with less flexibility but may need another API later for project sources.

options.title: Keep existing allowlists only
options.body: Decline new source-level config and document `agents.*.skills`, `skills.entries.*.enabled`, and prompt limits as mitigations, leaving scan/watch behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Add typed source-disable list
recommendation.body: Expose a bounded `skills.load.disabledSources` style setting with known source ids, default it to empty, and make loader, watcher, status, docs, and tests honor it.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has recent skills-loader and watcher ownership signals and is the best available routing candidate for the config/product choice.
